name: gen_jump
prompt: A person crouches and jumps straight up powerfully, tucking their knees at the peak, then lands and absorbs the impact
note: Launch core only. Take 6 of 8 (seed 0). Pelvis arc: stance 0.96 m held to 0.30 s, crouch bottom 0.75 m at 0.55 s, feet leave the ground at 0.70 s (foot_contacts 4 -> 0), apex 1.36 m at 0.95 s = +0.40 m rise, second-highest of the batch. Trim 0.30-1.00 s keeps one frame of stance before the crouch and one frame of hang past apex: the clip opens in a stance pose (no pop blending out of idle) and ends knees-tucked at the top, where the fall loop takes over. 0.70 s shipped against a 0.40 s gameplay jump = 1.75x retime. Chosen over take 1 (higher apex +0.46 m but its crouch descent alone spans 0.40 s, forcing the trim to open in a deep squat, and its foot contacts shuffle after touchdown) and over take 4 (+0.45 m apex but 0.34 m of horizontal travel, wrong for a standing vertical jump). Take 6 flags clean, skate 0.03 m/s, lean 36 deg. Root X/Z detrended; root Y left for the y_mode knob. NOT visually verified with render_animation_strip: that tool only reads library clips, and the direct write is blocked by a stale MCP server image.
